title: Billionaire Bank Owner Poses As A Beggar To Test Grandson’s Bride, Her True Face Shocked Everyone!
tags: rich woman pretends to be poor
description:
She thought she was humiliating a powerless old beggar, but she had no idea who she was truly dealing with...

When Loretta Whitfield, the secret owner of Whitfield Trust Bank, disguises herself in worn clothes to test her grandson's ambitious fiancée Brittany, she never expected such cruelty. Brittany publicly mocks her, pours coffee over her hands, and kicks away her dignity. But while everyone walks away, Tiana, a humble cleaner struggling to pay for her mother’s dialysis, kneels down to help and gives her very last $20 bill.

Brittany thought she had secured fortune, power, and the wedding of her dreams. What she didn't know was that every single move was being watched, every fraudulent dollar was being tracked, and karma was waiting right at the altar.

title: He Left His Crippled Wife In A Storm For His Mistress—She Returns On Her Own Two Feet To Fire Him
description:
After five years of marriage and a tragic accident that left her in a wheelchair, Camille is heartlessly thrown out into a torrential storm by her husband Byron and his mother—all so his pregnant mistress can move in. Mocked as "barren" and left with nothing but her formulation notebook, Camille vows to return. 

Two years later, Byron thinks he's unstoppable after stealing her formulas to become "Inventor of the Year." But he has no idea that the broken old man who picked Camille up from the gate was Solomon Pemberton—the reclusive billionaire founder who just bought his entire company. 

When Camille walks into Byron's office on her own two feet with his termination letter in hand, every dark lie—from the drunk-driving crash to the fake paternity—unravels before the entire world.
